title: Eli Jones - Say it/Untold Stories
htmlContent:
Eli Jones has returned with a new single "Say it/Untold Stories," an authentic sound that is timeless. The sound is honest, with heartfelt lyrics filled with gems that connect like magic, as his story telling abilities shine, while also being ultra relatable to connect with the masses. The verses are strong and are delivered by a flow that is focused and in pocket, that brings it all home. Everyone need to add "Say it/Untold Stories" by Eli Jones to their playlist.
